req.title: /status/<code> accepts POST
req.statement: The system shall accept POST requests on /status/<code> and return the requested code.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[10] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that negative tests use NEG (or another non-EP heuristic), since EP is reserved for positive equivalence partitioning. Fix: change test[10] (test_post_status_404_client_error) heuristic from EP to NEG, which correctly classifies it as a negative/error-pathway test using the NEG heuristic. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_post_status_200_positive
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/status/200')
assert r.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_post_status_400_negative
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 400
Response code is not 200 or any other code
trace: R-HTTPBIN-046: client error pathway — 4xx returned when 4xx requested
tests.executable:

client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/status/400')
assert r.status_code == 400
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 500

tests.name: test_post_status_418_teapot

418 is a special-cased code in status_code() helper with custom data
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 418
Response body contains teapot ASCII art marker
trace: R-HTTPBIN-046: DT — special code 418 returns correct status and body
tests.executable:

client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/status/418')

assert r.status_code != 200

expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200, not 405

client = app.test_client()

tests.name: test_post_status_404_client_error
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 404
trace: R-HTTPBIN-046: NEG — 404 is a valid client-error code that must be echoed back
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/status/404')
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 200
assert r.status_code != 400
assert r.status_code != 405
